proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ _ n p h0
  have main : ∀ (n : ℕ), (∀ i j k : ℕ, i < j → j < k → k ≤ n + 2 → (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p i) (p j) (p k)).sign = 1) →
      ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), EuclideanGeometry.angle (p i) (p (i + 1)) (p (i + 2)) +
        EuclideanGeometry.angle (p (n + 1)) (p (n + 2)) (p 0) + EuclideanGeometry.angle (p (n + 2)) (p 0) (p 1) =
      ((n : ℝ) + 1) * Real.pi := by
    intro n
    have key : ∀ X A B C : P, (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A X B).sign = 1 → (EuclideanGeometry.oangle B X C).sign = 1 →
        (EuclideanGeometry.oangle A X C).sign = 1 →
        EuclideanGeometry.angle A X C = EuclideanGeometry.angle A X B + EuclideanGeometry.angle B X C := by
      intro X A B C h1 h2 h3
      have hlt : ∀ U W : P, (EuclideanGeometry.oangle U X W).sign = 1 → EuclideanGeometry.angle U X W < Real.pi := by
        intro U W h
        apply EuclideanGeometry.angle_lt_pi_of_not_collinear
        rw [← EuclideanGeometry.oangle_sign_eq_zero_iff_collinear, h]
        decide
      have hadd := EuclideanGeometry.oangle_add (EuclideanGeometry.left_ne_of_oangle_sign_eq_one h1)
        (EuclideanGeometry.right_ne_of_oangle_sign_eq_one h1) (EuclideanGeometry.right_ne_of_oangle_sign_eq_one h2)
      rw [EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one h1, EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one h2,
        EuclideanGeometry.oangle_eq_angle_of_sign_eq_one h3, ← Real.Angle.coe_add, Real.Angle.angle_eq_iff_two_pi_dvd_sub] at hadd
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := hadd
      have a1 := hlt _ _ h1
      have a2 := hlt _ _ h2
      have a3 := hlt _ _ h3
      have b1 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg A X B
      have b2 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg B X C
      have b3 := EuclideanGeometry.angle_nonneg A X C
      have hpi := Real.pi_pos
      have hk0 : k = 0 := by
        have u1 : (k : ℝ) < 1 := by
          by_contra hc
          push Not at hc
          nlinarith
        have u2 : (-1 : ℝ) < k := by
          by_contra hc
          push Not at hc
          nlinarith
        have u1' : k < 1 := by exact_mod_cast u1
        have u2' : -1 < k := by exact_mod_cast u2
        omega
      rw [hk0] at hk
      simp at hk
      linarith
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro h
      have hne : p 1 ≠ p 0 := (EuclideanGeometry.left_ne_of_oangle_sign_eq_one (h 0 1 2 (by norm_num) (by norm_num) (by norm_num))).symm
      have := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi (p 2) hne
      simp
      linarith
    | succ n ih =>
      intro h
      have ih' := ih (fun i j k hij hjk hk => h i j k hij hjk (by omega))
      rw [Finset.sum_range_succ]
      have s1 : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 0) (p (n + 1)) (p (n + 2))).sign = 1 := h _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      have s2 : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 0) (p (n + 2)) (p (n + 3))).sign = 1 := h _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      have s3 : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p (n + 1)) (p (n + 2)) (p (n + 3))).sign = 1 := h _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      have s4 : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 0) (p 1) (p (n + 2))).sign = 1 := h _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      have s5 : (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p 0) (p 1) (p (n + 3))).sign = 1 := h _ _ _ (by omega) (by omega) (by omega)
      have r : ∀ U W Z : P, (EuclideanGeometry.oangle U W Z).sign = 1 → (EuclideanGeometry.oangle W Z U).sign = 1 := by
        intro U W Z hs
        rw [EuclideanGeometry.oangle_rotate_sign, hs]
      have k1 := key (p (n + 2)) (p (n + 1)) (p 0) (p (n + 3)) (r _ _ _ s1) s2 s3
      have k2 := key (p 0) (p (n + 3)) (p (n + 2)) (p 1) (r _ _ _ (r _ _ _ s2)) (r _ _ _ (r _ _ _ s4)) (r _ _ _ (r _ _ _ s5))
      have hne : p (n + 2) ≠ p 0 := (EuclideanGeometry.left_ne_of_oangle_sign_eq_one s2).symm
      have t := EuclideanGeometry.angle_add_angle_add_angle_eq_pi (p (n + 3)) hne
      push_cast
      simp only [show n + 1 + 2 = n + 3 by ring, show n + 1 + 1 = n + 2 by ring] at *
      linarith
  have h1 := main n h0
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_range, nsmul_eq_mul]
  push_cast
  linarith
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] [Module.Oriented ℝ V (Fin 2)] (n : ℕ) (p : ℕ → P), (∀ i j k : ℕ, i < j → j < k → k ≤ n + 2 → (EuclideanGeometry.oangle (p i) (p j) (p k)).sign = 1) → ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (Real.pi - EuclideanGeometry.angle (p i) (p (i + 1)) (p (i + 2))) + (Real.pi - EuclideanGeometry.angle (p (n + 1)) (p (n + 2)) (p 0)) + (Real.pi - EuclideanGeometry.angle (p (n + 2)) (p 0) (p 1)) = 2 * Real.pi
